query:
SELECT f.id, f.short_code
        FROM feedback AS f
        WHERE f.tenant_id = $1 AND f.project_id = $2
          AND f.short_code = ANY($3)
          AND f.moderation_status = 'approved'
          AND f.kind = 'feature'
          AND f.status NOT IN ('shipped', 'wontfix', 'duplicate')
        FOR SHARE
